contentHtml:
Globalization is making companies have a presence in several countries around the world, especially with remote work. However, many may find it difficult to comply with the local and national regulations of the host country. Therefore, the Employer of Record advantage allows the reduction of these inconveniences, in addition to other benefits.

In this article, we expose the benefits that you will get by hiring an EOR in the United Arab Emirates. Likewise, you will be able to know when you will need an employer of record in Dubai and what criteria to follow to hire the best one. Let us see:

  1. What does Employer of Rrecord mean?
  2. What are the pros and cons of a UAE Employer of Record?
  3. When should you look for the best Employer of Record services?
  4. How can you choose the best Employer of Record service in the UAE?
  5. How can we help you find the best Employer of Record?

1. What does Employer of Record mean?

A UAE Employer of Record is an organization that functions as a local entity for hiring employees from anywhere. In this way, the employer of record (EOR) will act as the employer for the worker in the host country. However, this organization will remain under your contract and you will manage the other aspects of your employees.

Consequently, the employer of record advantage is that it does the hiring, maintains compliance, handles payroll, etc.

2. What are the pros and cons of a UAE Employer of Record?

By hiring an Employer of Record, you will enjoy a variety of advantages for your business. However, there may also be certain disadvantages that you should consider when hiring these services. Next, we start with the Employer of Record advantage in the United Arab Emirates.

2.1 Advantages of hiring an EOR

By hiring the best Employer of Record service in the UAE you will obtain, among others, the following advantages:

2.1.1 Performs many functions for your business

An Employer of Record advantage is the ability to perform many tasks within your business. Thus, among the occupations of an EOR are:

  • Carry out the process of onboarding new employees of your company.
  • Hiring remote workers.
  • Management of all payroll or part of its activities.
  • The termination of contracts, among others.

Therefore, you should not worry about performing all these tasks, as they will be in the hands of professionals. The important thing in these cases is to find the best Employer of Record service in Dubai or another Emirate. Likewise, an EOR has specialized software for processing the payroll of the business, to manage everything necessary.

In addition, the Employer of Record advantage in terms of payroll is compliance with the UAE’s new labor laws.

2.1.2 Compliance with laws and regulations

Hiring a top Employer of Record service, you ensure compliance with the labor laws of the country of origin of the employee. Therefore, if you are looking to hire remote employees, the employer of record is an ideal solution for your business. In this way, you will not have to worry about compliance with very changeable laws.

Thanks to an Employer of Record in Dubai, for example, your business will be calm, as they will handle the responsibilities in Dubai.

2.1.3 Growth for your business

Another Employer of Record advantage is that you can focus on expanding your business without any problem. This is something every business owner wants and with an EOR you can achieve sustained expansion. Therefore, with these professionals, you can hire employees without the need to establish a subsidiary in the local commercial market.

Additionally, with the best Employer of Record services, you get the best of a Human Resources department. Thus, you will get administrative HR services, as well as all the work arrangements your business needs, without huge costs. Plus, you will have the time to improve your profits and capital to grow your company.

Similarly, an EOR can advise you on any concerns your employees may have. In this way, a Dubai Employer of Record helps you meet all the corporate objectives you have set.

2.1.4 Maintains its alignment with the culture of your business

Another Employer of Record advantage is that it ensures that the employees hired will follow the corporate culture of your business. In addition, potential candidates will be more attracted by promoting a healthy and safe work environment. It also provides a much easier hiring process for applicants, due to its local integration.

However, a good top Employer of Record service maintains communication with its client to find out their needs. Thus, an EOR also helps you establish the profile of the employee that best fits your company. For example, you can present a detailed specification of the reasons for hiring an employee and not an independent contractor.

2.1.5 You will get a good price-service ratio

The main characteristic of the best Employer of Record service in the UAE is to offer it at the best price. Thus, it must not only carry out all the necessary activities but also do it with the best possible quality. Therefore, this service is recommended for any company, especially emerging ones due to its profitability.

For example, an employer of record in Dubai takes tax filing into their hands, taking responsibility forany drawback.

2.2 Cons of hiring UAE Employer of Record

As we have seen, the employer of record advantage is evident in many aspects of your company. However, you may find certain disadvantages, which will not necessarily make you think twice about seeking these services. However, if you hire the best employer of record service in Dubai, these situations can be handled easily.

2.2.1 Less control over administrative matters

It may happen that, in certain aspects related to your employees, you feel that you have no control over it. This is inconvenient if you want constant control over all operations involving your workers. In addition, you may not be able to have a solid connection with your workers because you will not manage the training process.

2.2.2 Differences in hiring standards

It may happen that with an Employer of Record in Dubai you have differences in terms of employee selection criteria. Thus, if the criteria used by the EOR do not match your own, you may find yourself with the wrong employee. Therefore, look for the best employer of record service in the UAE that matches your vision and goals.

3. When should you look for the best Employer of Record services?

Since you have been able to see the Employer of Record advantage, you should inquire if you need to hire the services of this organization. Next, you will find the criteria that will help you determine if you need an Employer of Record:

  1. You can search for a Dubai Employer of Record if you do not want to establish a legal entity there but want to hire staff. In this way, you can guarantee an appropriate workforce in a short time, for an affordable rate for your business.
  2. Also, if you need to hire workers who do not qualify as independent contractors, you will need an EOR. This way, you will not make the mistake of misclassifying an employee, which leads to fines and penalties.
  3. The best employer of record service in the UAE is also useful when an employee wishes to relocate. That is when the employee wants to continue working in his business and the organization allows him to work remotely.
  4. Determining if a worker qualifies as an employee or independent contractor is vital to avoid legal problems. This is because the rules for employee misclassification are getting tougher. Therefore, as an EOR knows the rules for this classification, its hiring is ideal for these cases.
  5. Top Employer of Record services help protect your intellectual property in the host country. So, this organization guarantees that you will not have risks of infringement of your intellectual property.
  6. Another employer of record advantage that is used to determine if you need one is to help you comply with tax regulations. As we mentioned earlier, an EOR knows the labor laws and regulations that govern employment. Therefore, their advice and work are important in the case of international contracts.

4. How can you choose the best Employer of Record service in the UAE?

To choose the best Employer of Record service in Dubai or another Emirate, you can focus on the following characteristics:

4.1 The reputation of the organization

One of the first things to consider is the reputation of the company you want to work with. Therefore, inquire about the experience of the EOR, as well as which companies it has performed work for. Also, you should find a Dubai Employer of Record with whom you have no problem complying with the laws.

4.2 The type of service offered

Another important point when deciding to hire a UAE Employer of Record is to be clear about what services it offers. Thus, a good EOR is one capable of offering you a service adapted to your needs. In addition, to solve any inconvenience, you must offer a good effective communication system in case of doubts or suggestions.

4.3 Experience in the local labor market

A company that offers a top employer of record service must have sufficient experience in all the fields in which it works. You must be able to offer your services with a high level of professionalism and efficiency to achieve compliance. The first point in which we refer to reputation is integrated with their history of success.

4.4 Employee benefits

A great Employer of Record advantage is also that it offers an attractive benefits system for employees. Thus, by having the opportunity to work with several companies, they are prepared to provide very adequate benefits. Therefore, they represent a great help for small or medium-sized companies that cannot do it by themselves.

So ask what benefits the EOR offers and how you can guarantee them to your employees. We are not only talking about monetary benefits but also those that provide a better standard of living for the worker.

4.5 The technological systems they use

The best Employer of Record services has state-of-the-art technology for the execution of the various tasks offered. In this way, they work more efficiently in the processing of payroll, taxes, and certification compliance. Also, assess your security infrastructure so that all of your business data is fully protected from any cyberattack.
